lead.headline: Tuten missed Thursday — and he is still in a slot nobody can cover
lead.deck: Move him to FLEX and Gordon to RB before Sunday noon. Waddle has cleared the protocol and is a live fallback.
lead.body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Thursday after a limited Wednesday — the ankle and foot he played through last week. The lineup has not changed since Wednesday afternoon: Diggs in FLEX, Gordon on the bench, every back you own locking at 12:00. If Jacksonville declare Tuten inactive at 13:55, nobody can replace him. Put Gordon in an RB slot and Tuten in FLEX: it is the projection lineup, and it makes Waddle (15:25) and Diggs (Monday) live fallbacks. Waddle has cleared the concussion protocol. Jefferson's quarterback is Kirk Cousins — Kyler Murray missed Wednesday and Thursday — and Addison is out again. Pittman was a full participant Thursday, a threat to Metcalf's share. Fairbairn kicks tonight with Marks and Harrison Jr. ruled out for Houston.

doFirst.deck: Gordon to RB, Tuten to FLEX, Diggs to the bench.

Changes if Friday rules him out — then Waddle or Diggs starts outright.
